description: This file defines classes and enums related to a modem service in a modem simulator, including command handling, error codes, and service management.

classes.name: CommandHandler
classes.description: Handles registration and execution of commands with associated callback functions, supporting full and partial matching modes.

classes.name: ModemService
classes.description: Abstract base class for modem services, providing command handling, error code constants, and remote connection management.

methods.name: CommandHandler(const std::string& command, f_func handler)
methods.description: Constructor for command handler with full match callback.

methods.name: CommandHandler(const std::string& command, p_func handler)
methods.description: Constructor for command handler with partial match callback.

methods.name: int Compare(const std::string& command) const
methods.description: Compares input command with registered command prefix.

methods.name: void HandleCommand(const Client& client, std::string& command) const
methods.description: Executes the associated callback if the command matches.

methods.name: bool HandleModemCommand(const Client& client, std::string command)
methods.description: Handles a modem command, returning success or failure.

methods.name: ModemService(int32_t service_id, std::vector<CommandHandler> command_handlers, ChannelMonitor* channel_monitor, ThreadLooper* thread_looper)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the modem service with command handlers and communication components.

methods.name: void SendUnsolicitedCommand(std::string unsol_command)
methods.description: Sends an unsolicited command to the client.

methods.name: cuttlefish::SharedFD ConnectToRemoteCvd(std::string port)
methods.description: Establishes a connection to a remote CVD process.

methods.name: void SendCommandToRemote(ClientId remote_client, std::string response)
methods.description: Sends a command response to a remote client.
